'''Fane Peturri''' was a [[Historian/Legends|historian]] and a friend of [[Schurk-Heren]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' who was willing to trade [[Dreypa's Oubliette]].

==Biography==
Fane Peturri was a human [[Historian/Legends|historian]]<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: Dark Times: Vector]]''</ref> who lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> Three months after the [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration of the New Order]],<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">''[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]'' establishes the [[Declaration of a New Order]] as occurring in 16:5, while ''Dark Times 11: Vector, Part 5'' states that the duel on unidentified desert moon occurred three months after the the formation of the Empire.</ref> he was contacted by Captain [[Schurk-Heren]] of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' to sell on a [[Unidentified desert moon|desert moon]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] the "[[Dreypa's Oubliette|Jebble Box]]," found on the planet [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]].<ref name=":0" />

[[Schurk-Heren]] was willing to trade his vessel's valuable cargo, as he believed that Fane had no underworld connections. However, once arrived to conclude the trade, Peturri was revealed to be an agent of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who [[Janks|learned]] of the ship's cargo and set a trap for the crew. Peturri then began studying the oubliette and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifacts with it. He discovered a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph|crime lord's]] memoirs and a [[Zayne Carrick|Jedi]] who interrupted him about [[rakghoul]]s. Fane determined that the oubliette was made in a pre-Republic era.<ref name=":0" />

Against Fane's warnings about the [[Muur Talisman]] and its power to create rakghouls inside, Vader sliced it open, revealing a [[Celeste Morne|young woman]], inside. In a panic, Fane put on a suit to keep from getting infected. As soon as Celeste woke up, he told her that it was four thousand years from her previous time. She then bombarded him with questions about a [[Jedi Covenant|Covenant]], rakghouls, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. When he informed her that the Sith had taken over, she immediately attacked Vader.<ref name=":0" />

When the duel came to a halt, Peturri tried to run off to Vader's [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|transport]], but was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force grabbed]] by Vader in the process, who figured out that this was another test from [[Palpatine/Legends|his master]]. Fane confessed that he was indeed forced by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] that sensed in Vader the desire to usurp him and to find an apprentice to aid him in his quest.<ref name=":0" />

Fane's special suit did not shield him from the effects of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], so he transformed into a rakghoul. He was cut off in the air, as he tried to attack the Sith Lord, instantly dying.<ref name=":0" />
